sources.groq_headers: x-ratelimit-limit-requests = RPD, x-ratelimit-limit-tokens = TPM (per Groq docs)
sources.samba_docs: https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits read 2026-11-15 (free tier: RPM, RPD, TPD per model)

caveats: Limits are per model per organization: each model is an independent bucket.
Cerebras is trial/paid credit, not a permanent free tier: these limits say nothing about remaining credit.
null = not published/observed; never treat as unlimited.
accounts: providers that pool limits across every model on one key/IP; one bucket each.

models.note: docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits read 2026-11-15: every free-tier model listed is 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200k TPD; GLM-5.3 itself is not listed, so the tier value is assumed
groot llama-server :11530, no provider quota; 30 rpm is a self-imposed cap so lanes do not queue on one GPU slot

openrouter.basis: openrouter.ai/docs/api/reference/limits: 20 RPM, 1000 RPD on :free with >=10 credits, per account

kilo.basis: Kilo gateway anonymous :free, ~200 req/h per IP (PROMOTION_MODEL_LIMIT_REACHED)

nim.basis: build.nvidia.com free API, ~40 RPM per account

cohere.basis: docs.cohere.com/docs/rate-limits: trial key 20 RPM chat, 1000 calls/month (~33/day), per account

zai.basis: Z.ai flash models are free with low concurrency; no published RPM, conservative 10 until measured

llm7.basis: llm7.io publishes no hard numbers for anonymous use; conservative until measured
